Hi Samantha — thanks for reaching out. Looping in Rishi (payments) and Stephanie (sales ops) so we can close the loop quickly. Below is what QuarryLabs should provide and what Redwood requires to prevent PO-match exceptions.

What we need from you (vendor-registration fields):
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit name (if different): Redwood Inference
- US EIN / EU VAT: EU VAT: GB999999973 (example) — provide your internal tax ID if you need us to apply reverse-charge processing
- Registered billing address and a primary AP contact (name/phone/email)

Invoice / PO matching requirements (please share with your system):
- Put the PO number in the invoice header and in the filename (PO-87-2001). We do not require line-level PO IDs for standard services; PO header-level matching is sufficient for this contract.
- Required fields: Invoice number, invoice date, PO number, invoice total, currency, VAT amount (if applicable), vendor VAT number.
- Preferred formats: PDF (preferred), UBL/PEPPOL XML accepted for e-invoicing.

Tax & VAT handling
- We can accept EU reverse-charge for QuarryLabs invoices if you are VAT-registered in the EU and show the VAT number on the invoice. Please include the reverse-charge phrase on the invoice (e.g., "VAT reverse charge applies — Article X").
- We do not accept self-billing for new customers by default; if you need self-billing, we'll have to run a compliance exception and get procurement sign-off (usually lengthens activation).

Payments / remit
- Send invoices to: ap@redwoodinference.com (subject: PO-87-2001 | QuarryLabs)
- Default terms: Net 30 from invoice date unless an early-pay agreement is in place.
- For wire transfers: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Bank: First Atlas Bank; IBAN: GB12ATLS00000000001234 (we will provide a signed remit confirmation if you need it)

Attachments I'm sending: AP onboarding packet (fields & sample invoices), plus a sample EU invoice template. Fill out your vendor form and send back and we'll route to finance.

Hi Samantha — Rishi on Payments. Quick answers to the three bullets:

1) Consolidated PO billing: Yes, we can accept consolidated invoices against PO 87-2001 provided each invoice lists the internal charge codes in the invoice body and the invoice lines map to the consolidated total. We do a header-level PO match for this account, but line details help AP verify GL mapping and speed payment. If you can include the QuarryLabs charge code column, that reduces exceptions.

2) Early-pay discounts: We prefer to receive the invoice at full amount. For early-pay programs, QuarryLabs can provide a remittance instruction / discount confirmation file to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com and we will process the discount as a payment transaction adjustment. We do not modify the supplier's invoice amount itself. If the discount needs to appear on the remittance, include a short remittance file in the payment portal upload or email with the invoice.

3) Reverse-charge phrasing: Please include a clear VAT reverse-charge statement on the invoice ("Reverse charge — Article 196, Council Directive 2006/112/EC" or your local equivalent). The vendor VAT number alone is not sufficient for audit — we need the statement and the VAT number.

Operational notes:
- Invoices that fail to include the PO number or vendor VAT number will be held and we will open a ticket; typical resolution 3–5 business days.
- For e-invoicing via Peppol: send to our Peppol ID: 9908:REDWOOD-EINV.

I've added a HubSpot note (QL-3482) and an Ops ticket. Once we have the VAT cert scanned and your filled form, we'll provision you for test invoices.
